text:
maria: Morning — onboarded llm-llama3-tinyq-v2 to staging. Ran quick eval on `promptset-es-v1`. Overall pass rate dropped to 92% (was 98%). Found tokenization mismatch for Spanish quotes and some long tokens.

sam: Can you paste a failing example?

maria: Input: "¿Cuál es la capital de España?" -> Expected: "Madrid"; Model returned: "La capital es Madrid, pero..." (extra hallucinated clause). Sample run:
```
input: ¿Cuál es la capital de España?
output: La capital es Madrid, situada en el centro... 
```
Probable cause: KV cache alignment + tokenizer BOS tokens for Spanish punctuation.

alex: @maria I skimmed PR #456 (tokenizer fixes) — changes look reasonable. Need vocab regen + small detokenize patch. I can run a smoke eval on Dedicated after lunch.

priya: tagging @eng-runtime — could kv-cache warmup order differ between quantized vs full models? Saw similar with tiny-q last month.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for llm-llama3-tinyq-v2 on staging at 13:30 UTC. Rollback window 10m.

maria: Blockers: need someone to run the 50k-sample eval on Dedicated (memory/throughput), and approval for PR #456 so I can regenerate artifacts. Otherwise I'll pin to v1.4 for prod.

sam: I can run the heavy eval after 14:00 UTC. Will post results here. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll +1 the PR after CI passes. One note — add a unit test for Spanish punctuation detokenize.

maria: Thanks — left dataset + minimal instructions in /mnt/shared/onboard/llama3-tinyq-v2/README.md. Ping if infra errors.

priya: fyi I've added a quick watch on the model's latency metrics, no regressions so far. :eyes:

maria: Cool, updating rollout plan. Will do a tiny canary then full canary if evals look good.
